name: Magic
description: One of the four realms of power in Mythic Europe, the source of Hermetic magi's power; it idealizes things and is objective, ancient, and mysterious.

name: Divine
description: Realm of power whose adherents treat Magic as God's gift or the Devil's tool; Magic is lessened in the Dominion.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of power that can consume and corrupt Magic; demons often masquerade as magical beings.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of power concerned with subjective reality and interaction with humanity, both complementing and opposing Magic.

name: Magic Realm
description: A mysterious parallel to Heaven, Hell and Arcadia; an otherworld of magical locations joined by boundaries and vestiges, with a constant Magic aura of 10, where inhabitants do not age or gain experience.

name: Twilight Void
description: The sparse, dark part of the Magic Realm filled with omens and home to ancient powerful beings; the space between cosms or the time between times.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, in which the four realms of power interact.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura in which magical power is lessened.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi who hunt for vis, familiars, covenant sites and the mysteries of the Magic Realm.

name: Magic Aura
description: A location where things are superior or more real than normal; it affects Hermetic magic and supernatural power, and auras of 6+ cause Warping.

name: Tether
description: An object or circumstance of magical significance that attracts fluid vis to pool around it, forming the basis and center of a Magic aura.

name: Natural Tether
description: A tether consisting of perfect natural features or astrological alignments, scoring 1 or 2, such as caves, forests, ice, volcanoes, water or wind.

name: Preternatural Tether
description: A tether of non-natural origin caused by mortals, magic beings, or vis, scoring 1 to 5: magic monuments, magic residues, magic beings or vis sources.

name: Base Aura Score
description: The aura score generated by a site's tethers: the natural aura score plus the preternatural aura score.

name: Fluid Vis
description: The magical energy leaking from the Magic Realm that pools in magical areas to form auras; also called radiant vis or tellurian vis.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power in physical form, harvested from sources, expended in spellcasting, study and certamen, and manifesting in characters in the Magic Realm.

name: Vis Extraction
description: Magical activity that converts fluid vis into raw vis, generally believed to weaken a Magic aura.

name: Aether
description: Aristotle's fifth element, the celestial fire beyond the Lunar Sphere, equated by some magi with fluid vis.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: The celestial sphere of the moon, beyond which the aether exists; some imagine the Magic Realm just below it.

name: Aura Variation
description: Rules by which a Magic aura's current score deviates from its base score due to magical activity and impinging foreign auras.

name: Yearly Aura Modifier
description: The annual sum of effects on an aura; values beyond +/-3 trigger rolls on the Aura Strengthening or Weakening Tables.

name: Aura Strengthening Table
description: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is +4 or more, with outcomes from new regio levels to permanent aura increase.

name: Aura Weakening Table
description: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is -4 or less, with outcomes from vanished regio levels to permanent aura decrease.

name: Regio
description: A layered area of different aura levels separated by boundaries; Magic regiones arise from magical accidents or aura instability.

name: Aligned Aura
description: A Magic aura with a special aspect, such as enhancing an emotion or aligning with a Hermetic Art, discernible by Intellego Vim.

name: Emotion-Enhancing Aura
description: A Magic aura that grants or modifies Personality Traits of those without Magic-derived supernatural abilities, e.g. Aggressive, Carefree, Communicative, Respectful.

name: Art-Aligned Aura
description: An aura aligned with a Technique or Form that doubles the aura bonus for relevant spells and lab work and reduces power costs for aligned creatures.

name: Aura Effect Table
description: Table giving Personality Trait adjustments of +1 to +3 by aura level for emotion-enhancing auras.

name: Warping
description: Magical distortion caused by strong auras and botches, measured in Warping Points and Warping Score, which can cause Twilight.

name: Twilight
description: A magical state magi experience from Warping; Criamon magi believe it lies outside the circle of time.

name: Final Twilight
description: Permanent loss of a magus into Twilight; some magi entered it attempting to increase their covenant's aura.

name: Twilight Avoidance
description: Roll to avoid Twilight, also used to avoid magical disasters.

name: Magical Disaster
description: An overwhelming eruption of Magic that can transport wielders, objects or whole regions into the Magic Realm.

name: Cosm
description: A world in the Magic Realm connected to a thing in the mundane world; may be a microcosm or macrocosm.

name: Microcosm
description: A cosm bigger than the thing it is connected to, such as a country inside a pebble.

name: Macrocosm
description: A cosm embodying one aspect of a greater thing, a world greater than its parts.

name: Insula
description: In the Magic Archipelago theory, an island-like location of the Magic Realm, resembling a high-level Magic regio.

name: Tempus
description: In the Pages of History theory, a location in the Magic Realm that is a specific moment in history.

name: Worlds Within Worlds
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a collection of cosms each contained within a single thing.

name: Magic Archipelago
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a physical chain of islands (insulae) separated by the waters of the Twilight Void.

name: Pages of History
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a record of past events, composed of tempora.

name: Realm Boundary
description: The border outlining a location in the Magic Realm, level 0-10, aligned to a Form, granting magic bonuses, botch dice, and vis, and allowing travel.

name: Vestige
description: A perfect, insubstantial illusion in the Magic Realm aligned with a Form and connected to something in the mundane world; usable for travel.

name: Magical Travel
description: Travel through boundaries or vestiges, requiring Magic Might or powers like Second Sight, rolled against a level-based Ease Factor minus Familiarity.

name: Magic Might
description: The Might score of Magic creatures, aligned with a Form; allows passage into the Magic Realm through things of the same Form.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a thing or place; interrupted when brought into the Magic Realm and decaying faster in the Twilight Void.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: The magic of the Order of Hermes, affected by auras.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic theory of magic; its development may have involved study of Art-aligned sites.

name: Magic Lore
description: Knowledge of Magic needed to recognize its facts and theorize about the Magic Realm; aids Familiarity in magical travel.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: Ability whose score counts as a Familiarity modifier for magical travel.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge of an area; Area Lore (Magic Realm) gives triple its score as a Familiarity modifier.

name: Animal Ken
description: Suggested Virtue for inhabitants warped by a forest aura.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Suggested Virtue for inhabitants warped by a forest aura.

name: Animal Companion
description: May be acquired by inhabitants of a forest-tethered aura.

name: Dowsing
description: Suggested Virtue for inhabitants of a water-tethered aura.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Minor Virtue suggested for inhabitants of a volcanic aura.

name: Great Immunity
description: Virtue such as Great Immunity: Drowning, suggested for water-aura inhabitants.

name: Luck
description: Minor Virtue granting advantage where luck matters; stacks with Luck-aligned auras.

name: Second Sight
description: Power allowing a character to see through boundaries and vestiges for magical travel.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Special power allowing travel through boundaries and vestiges.

name: The Gift
description: The Magic-derived supernatural ability of magi; those with it are unaffected by emotion auras and aligned-aura Warping.

name: Sensitive Sight
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of cave or water auras.

name: Sensitive Hearing
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of wind auras.

name: Sensitive Smell
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of wind auras.

name: Sensitive to Heat
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of ice auras.

name: Sensitive to Cold
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Weak Sight
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of ice auras.

name: Weak Sense of Taste
description: Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Weak Sense of Smell
description: Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Fear
description: Minor Flaw such as a Fear of open spaces or vivid colors, suited to warped aura inhabitants.

name: Disfigured
description: Minor Flaw, e.g. pallid skin or webbed digits from aura Warping.

name: Oversensitive
description: Minor Flaw such as oversensitivity to damage to vegetation.

name: Weakness
description: Minor Flaw such as a weakness for natural bodies of water.

name: Visions
description: Minor Flaw such as seeing visions in cloud shapes.

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw likely acquired by unGifted characters in Vim-aligned auras at Warping Score 6.

name: Fine Aura
description: Major Site Boon: a covenant aura with an alignment benefiting most within it.

name: Favorable Aura
description: Minor Site Boon: a covenant aura aligned to favor one activity.

name: Troublesome Aura
description: Minor Site Hook: a covenant aura whose alignment hinders activities.

name: Personality Trait
description: Character trait that emotion-enhancing auras can grant or modify.

name: Essential Trait
description: A trait of magical beings that cannot be altered by aura effects.

name: Certamen
description: Magical dueling; using vis in it adds to an aura's fluid vis.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Ritual using vis that concentrates it into a person rather than the aura.

name: Familiar
description: Magical beast bound to a magus; attuning one concentrates vis into the beast.

name: Ritual Spell
description: Spells requiring vis; casting them adds to an aura's fluid vis.

name: Mystery Initiation
description: Initiation into Mysteries; reliably manipulating auras may require one.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Secret cults; one may know how to create Magic regiones.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Mystery whose initiates have a reliable, difficult method of improving a magic aura.

name: Breakthrough
description: Hermetic research advance; reliable aura manipulation may need a Major breakthrough.

name: Schism War
description: Period of Order history when potent magical accidents strengthened Magic auras.

name: Domus Magna
description: The chief covenant of a Hermetic House.

name: Sanctum
description: A magus's private quarters, which regio fracturing may separate from the rest of the covenant.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Mystery Cult suspected of knowing how to create Magic regiones; Mercurian rituals may strengthen auras.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House whose domus magna is Durenmar.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House whose domus magna Irencillia is a Faerie regio.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House whose magi view some regiones as adulteration and believe Twilight lies outside the circle of time.

name: Durenmar
description: Domus magna of House Bonisagus with base aura 6 and current aura 7; has a standing stone tether, a library, and magestones.

name: Harco
description: Covenant whose scroll reports a uniform Magic aura visited by a Redcap.

name: Irencillia
description: Domus magna of House Merinita, a regio arisen from a powerful event, with a Faerie aura.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing an urban covenant secretly holding magestones.

name: Verditius
description: Founder rumored to be able to create portable tethers called magestones.

name: Magestone
description: Portable tether rumored made by Verditius; Durenmar and a Rhine covenant hold some.

name: Aristotle
description: Philosopher whose fifth element (aether) and elemental theory are invoked in vis theory.

name: Empedocles
description: Ancient philosopher whose idea that time is a great circle inspired Criamon teaching.

name: Plato
description: Philosopher who described the sunken island of Atlantis.

name: Atlantis
description: Plato's sunken island, possibly taken into the Magic Realm by a magical disaster.

name: Prester John
description: Ruler of a magical kingdom in India sought via the Magic Realm in a story seed.

name: Kingdom of Prester John
description: Magical kingdom in India beyond Africa, reachable through the Magic Realm.

name: Pillars of Hercules
description: Strait beyond which an expedition passes into the Magic Realm.

name: Liver Sea
description: Sailors' name for coagulated waters in the Magic Realm that halt ships.

name: Circe
description: Figure whose cave exemplifies a Muto-aligned aura.

name: Circe's Cave
description: Example of a Muto-aligned aura.

name: Saint Peter
description: Saint whose book records all deeds for Judgment, an analogy for the Magic Realm.

name: Book of St. Peter
description: Book recording a person's thoughts and deeds for Judgment Day; analogy for tempora.

name: Lord Theobald
description: Example lord whose land ownership has a vestige in the Magic Realm.

name: Alps
description: Mountains whose first day of winter has a vestige in the Magic Realm.

name: Lord of Summer
description: Magic being who holds the Lady of Winter captive in his forest cosm castle.

name: Lady of Winter
description: Magic being held captive by the Lord of Summer, disrupting the seasons.

name: Wolf King
description: Being whose domain encompasses all wolves in England, a macrocosm.

name: Ferrymen
description: Travelers who navigate the waters between insulae; theorists of the Magic Archipelago.

name: Bernard
description: Young novice in the aligned aura example, made more cowardly by a fear aura.

name: Paul
description: Grog in the aligned aura example, normally Brave +3.

name: Ignatio
description: Grog in the aligned aura example, normally Courageous +2.

name: Elemental
description: Magical beings embodying the elements; water, fire and air elementals form preternatural tethers.

name: Dragon
description: Ancient magical beasts whose lairs form tethers.

name: Spirit
description: Magic beings bound to natural phenomena.

name: Ghost
description: Magical beings that may form tethers; demons may masquerade as them.

name: Frost Giant
description: Giants dwelling on an icy peak that forms a tether.

name: Dryad
description: Beings tending trees in a primeval forest tether.

name: Beast of Virtue
description: Magical animals exemplifying their kind.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings that masquerade as magical beings and are hindered in Magic places.

name: Water Siren
description: Magic Realm creature that charms sailors with song and summons storms.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard aligned to the Magic realm.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servant-warrior.

name: Redcap
description: Hermetic messenger.

name: Covenfolk
description: Non-magus inhabitants of a covenant.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Ritual spell whose casting adds to an aura's fluid vis.

name: Shadow of Life Renewed
description: 75th-level spell whose casting site might form a tether of 3.

name: Sense of Magical Power
description: Intellego Vim spell; variants can detect aura alignments.

name: Feeding the Font of the Covenant
description: CrVi Ritual causing an immediate Aura Strengthening roll.

name: Stratifying the Subtle Realities
description: CrVi Ritual variant making regio creation more likely.

name: Stripping the Superfluous Realities
description: PeVi 30 Ritual aiming to destroy a regio level via Aura Weakening roll.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Spell invested in items to leap home; fails in the Magic Realm without Arcane Connections.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique. Aligned auras make things healthy and abundant.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique. Intellego Vim can discern aura alignments.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique. Muto-aligned auras cause changes.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique. Perdo botches destroy fluid vis; aligned auras cause decay.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique. Rego-aligned auras show regularity.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form. Animal-aligned auras give inhabitants animal traits.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form. Aquam-aligned auras associate with water.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form. Auram-aligned auras associate with air.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form. Corpus-aligned auras aid healing.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form. Herbam-aligned auras associate with plants.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form. Ignem-aligned auras associate with fire.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form. Imaginem-aligned auras affect senses.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form. Mentem-aligned auras grant telepathy.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form. Terram-aligned auras associate with stone.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form. Hermetic Art governing auras.
